jobs.description:
Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions that provide reliable power and modernize infrastructure. Since 2000, we have served as a trusted partner to public and private sector customers across North America, the UK and Europe, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting more than 5 GW of energy resources .
 At Ameresco, we integrate energy resources and modernize the built environment through innovative infrastructure solutions that improve reliability, optimize performance, strengthen resilience, and support long-term sustainability.  Join us in building the infrastructure that powers the future. Explore opportunities to make a meaningful impact while growing your career with a company at the forefront of energy innovation.
 Position Overview: 
 Ameresco is hiring a Project Manager to deliver solar PV, distributed generation, and battery energy storage (BESS) projects across the U.S. You will own assigned projects from Notice to Proceed through commissioning, commercial operation, and closeout — accountable for scope, schedule, budget, subcontractor performance, and day-to-day client coordination and communication. The Project Manager may manage two to three projects concurrently, depending on project size, phase, and complexity.
 This is a hands-on execution role. You will independently manage projects of defined scope and complexity, escalating major commercial, schedule, or client issues to the Senior Director. The role provides an opportunity to progress toward Senior Project Manager based on demonstrated performance, business needs, and readiness for expanded responsibility.
 Responsibilities: 
 Project Delivery
 Own assigned projects from handoff through Final Completion, including the execution plan, milestones, and risk register.
 Partner with Pre-Construction to assess execution readiness, confirm scope, schedule, budget, procurement, permitting, and key risks, and establish a clear handoff into construction.
 Understand assigned project contracts and ensure key scope, schedule, notice, documentation, and commercial requirements are incorporated into project execution.
 Coordinate with Procurement and Engineering to track long-lead equipment, vendor submittals, manufacturing, delivery dates, and material risks.
 Serve as the day-to-day lead for clients, subcontractors, utilities, and internal teams.
 Coordinate design deliverables, submittals, RFIs, constructability reviews, and engineering resolutions to support procurement and field execution.
 Maintain organized and current project records, including contracts, drawings, submittals, RFIs, meeting minutes, notices, change documentation, and key correspondence.
 Identify risks early, propose mitigation, and escalate material commercial, schedule, or client issues to senior leadership.
 Permitting & Environmental Compliance
 Coordinate with AHJs, municipal and county officials, utilities, fire departments, and other regulatory agencies throughout project execution.
 Track permit applications, reviews, inspections, conditions, and closeout requirements to maintain the project schedule.
 Work with Pre-Construction, Engineering, site leadership, and environmental consultants to ensure permitting and regulatory requirements are incorporated into the execution plan.
 Coordinate with site leadership and environmental consultants to maintain compliance with applicable permits and environmental requirements, including wetlands, stormwater, erosion and sediment controls, SWPPP, and other site-specific obligations.
 Coordinate utility and interconnection requirements, inspections, witness testing, documentation, and approvals required for energization and commercial operation.
 Escalate permitting or compliance issues that may affect construction, schedule, cost, or project turnover.
 Schedule & Cost Control
 Maintain project schedules and short-term look-aheads; track critical path, procurement, and utility milestones.
 Manage budgets, forecasts, cost-to-complete, and contingency.
 Identify schedule variance early and work with subcontractors, Construction Management, and internal teams to develop, document, implement, and monitor recovery plans.
 Identify potential changes early; maintain supporting notices, cost records, schedule impacts, and documentation; and review pay applications, invoices, and change orders for scope, cost, schedule impact, and contractual support, escalating significant entitlement issues for commercial or leadership review.
 Subcontractor Management
 Set clear expectations for scope, schedule, safety, quality, and documentation.
 Confirm subcontract scopes, exclusions, deliverables, schedule obligations, and closeout requirements are understood and enforced throughout execution.
 Run recurring coordination meetings and track actions to closure.
 Maintain alignment with the Construction Manager or site lead on field priorities, constraints, subcontractor performance, and upcoming work.
 Validate reported progress against field conditions with Construction Management.
 Field, Safety & Quality
 Visit sites regularly to verify progress and resolve issues.
 Reinforce Ameresco, client, and regulatory safety expectations; coordinate with site leadership to address identified safety concerns; and track quality issues and punch lists to resolution.
 Commissioning, Closeout & Reporting
 Coordinate commissioning, energization, and turnover with Engineering, OEMs, and utilities.
 Drive physical, contractual, and financial closeout, including punch lists, as-builts, O&M manuals, warranties, lien releases, subcontractor closeout, final billing, coordination of the reconciliation and release of remaining project commitments in accordance with company approval requirements, and turnover to Operations.
 Deliver weekly status reports on schedule, cost, risk, and change orders.
 Support prevailing-wage, certified-payroll, and IRA compliance documentation.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Minimum of 5 years of construction or project management experience on renewable, power, electrical, industrial, or EPC/Design-Build projects.
 Working knowledge of scheduling, budgeting, forecasting, change management, and subcontract administration.
 Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
 Strong communication and organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities.
 Willingness to travel to project sites; valid driver's license.
 Additional Qualifications: 
 Solar PV or BESS project experience, including commissioning.
 Familiarity with applicable solar PV and BESS codes, standards, utility requirements, and coordination with fire departments and other AHJs.
 Familiarity with prevailing-wage, Davis-Bacon, and IRA compliance.
 Microsoft Project, Procore, or similar tools.
 OSHA 30; PMP or CCM a plus.

Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed.  We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
 Job Description 
 Participates in the identification, design, development and implementation of assigned projects. Assigned projects may be general or systems related in nature. Interfaces with internal and external resources to ensure successful and timely completion in accordance with user needs. Participates in training users and evaluating the project. Manages performance of the project team and evaluates overall team performance. 
 Basic Qualifications 
 - Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience 
 - Eight to ten years of experience in project management activities 
 Preferred Skills/Experience 
· Considerable knowledge of assigned business line or functional area
 ·  Demonstrated management and leadership skills
 ·  Strong organizational and analytical skills
 ·  Advanced knowledge of project management
 ·  Ability to identify and resolve exceptions and to analyze data
 ·  Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 ·  Master's degree preferred
 ·   Deep, hands-on Jira expertise , including Initiative structures, workflows, field management, dependencies, filters, JQL, dashboards, and reporting capabilities that improve visibility into prioritized work.
 ·  Experience managing Initiatives, programs, or a defined segment of prioritized portfolio work, maintaining accurate Initiative information, and translating delivery updates into clear status reporting.
 ·  Experience collaborating across business and technology teams to coordinate dependencies, clarify accountability, identify and escalate risks and blockers, and coordinate follow-up to support progress without direct authority.
 ·  Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication capabilities.
 ·  Ability to relate business experience to upstream and downstream technologies
 ·  Experience spanning the systems development lifecycle, end-to-end business testing, information management, and product and vendor evaluation, with a working knowledge of Enterprise systems and capabilities supporting credit card platforms, including Digital, Branch Banking, KYC, and Customer Profile Management.
 ·  Deep knowledge of the credit card lifecycle—from marketing and application through onboarding, engagement, use, and account management—with expertise in requirements elicitation, Initiative- and Feature-level refinement, and workflow process modeling.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Jira Management:
 Jira Initiative Ownership: Manage and own Jira Initiatives for an assigned segment of prioritized work within PCS, maintaining accountability for Initiative tracking, coordination, and visibility throughout the delivery lifecycle.
 Jira Expertise and Record Management: Apply deep knowledge of Jira to maintain Initiative records, workflows, required fields, status updates, milestones, dependencies, and links to supporting work.

 Data Quality and Governance: Ensure assigned Initiative records are complete, accurate, current, and aligned with established PCS Jira standards and governance practices.
 Status Communication: Provide concise Initiative updates that support shared understanding of progress, risks, blockers, and required actions.
 Refinement Architect:
 Cross-Portfolio Refinement: Refinement support for larger complex Initiatives and leading lower complexity initiatives (25% of role will be focused on refinement).
 Feature-to-Initiative Alignment: Ensure teams impacted align their Features to the appropriate Initiatives and maintain clear traceability across the work.
 Technical Solutioning: Participate in technical solutioning to help ensure proposed solutions meet the needs of the business and customers.
 Demo Engagement and Validation: Participate in demos to validate that delivered outputs align with defined features and intended business outcomes.
 Initiative and Feature Health: Monitor and maintain the health, accuracy, and currency of Jira Initiatives and features throughout refinement and delivery.
 Program Support and Escalation: Remain engaged in program meetings to support necessary scope changes and provide input on program risks, dependencies, and escalations.
 Executive-Level Delivery Summaries: Provide executive-level summaries of feature delivery in clear business and customer terms, along with concise status updates as needed.

 Understanding of operational policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements applicable to financial services activities

 Ready to modernize medicine with us? 
 Job Description Summary: 
 The Project Manager will be responsible for the entire project life cycle of ModMed solution implementations, focusing primarily on Key and early Strategic customer (1-10 provider) accounts. This includes leveraging Project Management knowledge to effectively lead the implementation while also consulting with the customer on best practices to mitigate risk and achieve success. This role requires a high degree of strategic thinking along with collaboration with our Sales, Training Services, Technology Services, Business Consulting, and Customer Success organizations.
 Role & Responsibilities 
 Responsible for independently managing the successful delivery and implementation of ModMed’s solutions, including both internal and external deliverables, internal and external customer stakeholder management, and achievement of ModMed’s KPIs for billable utilization, time-to-revenue, CSAT, and adoption. (25%)
 Receive deals from sales, review all knowledge transfer documentation, and order forms to ensure proper project initiation. Based on this, draft a project kick-off and timeline, initiating technical projects and securing tactical resources (training/BC) to lead to a successful implementation.
 Develop detailed work plans, schedules, project timelines, and status reports, using these to conduct regular project calls and/or executive steering committees as necessary.
 Document, update, and maintain all work and time entries in CRM, Project Management tools, or other tools as appropriate from the point of sales hand off till project close.
 Field and manage change requests to balance project risk, delivery KPIs, adoption success, and customer satisfaction. Facilitate necessary change orders, credits, order forms, or addendums via Salesforce/CPQ or Operations teams. (10%)
 Escalate at-risk projects to management and leadership levels as appropriate. Provide executive summaries, recommendations on resolution, or specific requests for support. (10%)
 Collaborate with all internal and external parties to ensure alignment on delivery and mitigation of risk. Internally, this includes but is not limited to Patient Engagement Project Management, Trainers, Technical Consultants, Business Consultants, Sales Managers, Product, or Customer Success Managers. Oversee any necessary iteration of the mutual project plans to ensure success. (10%)
 At times, travel for Project Kick-Off, Project Status, Go-Live, or Project Close at the client’s location; availability for up to 25% travel required (10%)
 Maintain updated knowledge and experience for ModMed’s products, healthcare service implementations, Project Management methodologies. This may include early access and contribution towards development of new methodologies, tools, or product offerings ModMed is looking to provide. (10%)

 Bachelor’s Degree; Preferred - Business, Healthcare or similar

 PMP Certification preferred

 United States

jobs.description:
We are seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented  Quality and Compliance Writer/Project Coordinator  to lead the development, maintenance, and publication of company policies and procedures across multiple operational departments. This role is primarily focused on policy writing and governance—ensuring policies are clear, current, adopted by process owners, and effectively implemented across the organization.
 The ideal candidate will also bring a solid working understanding of ISO and CMMI and how these frameworks relate to operational controls, documentation, and audit readiness. This role emphasizes how compliance with policy is established, communicated, and sustained across departments (e.g., IT, security, HR, operations, project teams). The position requires autonomy, discipline, strong stakeholder communication, and critical thinking, with experience using AI tools in the workplace to improve the quality and efficiency of documentation work.
 Primary Focus Areas (Estimated) 
 Policy Governance & Policy Writing Drafting, editing, publishing, maintaining, and improving company policies/procedures
 Coordinating reviews/approvals, version control, and periodic policy refresh cycles
 Driving adoption and implementation with operational departments
 Managing document updates and control with multiple stakeholders across departments
 Dayton, OH location preferred. Preference will be given to East Coast candidates based on business need. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the end-to-end policy lifecycle: draft, write, edit, format, publish, and maintain company policies and procedures, including version control and periodic reviews
 Partner with department leads and process owners to collect inputs, clarify responsibilities, and ensure policies reflect how work is actually performed
 Drive policy compliance and adoption by coordinating approvals, communicating updates, and supporting implementation across operational departments
 Translate compliance requirements into practical, usable policies that align to business needs and applicable frameworks (including ISO and CMMI)
 Develop and maintain supporting documentation (e.g., standards, procedures, templates, guidance) to enable consistent execution of policies
 Occasionally support ISO/CMMI-related audit readiness by ensuring policy documentation and evidence expectations are well-organized and aligned to requirements
 Apply critical thinking to identify gaps, risks, and inconsistencies; recommend improvements and corrective actions
 Communicate effectively with stakeholders at multiple levels; track action items and follow through to closure
 Leverage AI tools appropriately to support drafting, editing, summarization, and process/document optimization (in alignment with company guidelines)
 Required Skill Set 
 Strong experience in professional writing, editing, and document control—especially policy and procedure writing (2-5 years)
 Experience policy writing in a government contracting organization a huge plus (2+ years)
 Working knowledge/experience with organizational policy compliance (how policies are implemented, monitored, and reinforced across departments) (2+ years)
 Experience supporting or working within ISO and/or CMMI environments (audit readiness, documentation, quality processes, or process improvement) (1-3 years)
 Ability to work autonomously with a high degree of discipline, prioritization, and attention to detail
 Strong stakeholder communication skills: gather requirements, resolve ambiguity, and drive timely reviews/approvals
 Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; ability to evaluate processes and recommend practical improvements
 Experience utilizing AI in the workplace to improve efficiency and quality of written deliverables (e.g., drafting, rewriting, summarizing, formatting)
 Proficiency with office suite tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); comfort working in collaborative document environments
 Qualifications 
 Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship 
 2-5 years policy and process governance, compliance documentation, or quality management strongly preferred
 ISO/CMMI experience are a plus; training can be provided for the right candidate
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
 Project coordination experience highly desired 
 Employment Details 
 Supportive, collaborative work environment with a focus on professional growth
 Competitive compensation dependent on experience and skills

DDC is dedicated to empowering the Navajo Nation and the communities we serve.

jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With: 
 Private Wealth Portfolio Management Group is responsible for implementing investment strategies across our private client portfolios. As our business continues to grow and client needs become increasingly sophisticated, the team plays an important role in ensuring portfolios are implemented accurately and efficiently while incorporating client-specific requirements, including tax considerations and customization. 
 The Portfolio Management Group works closely with Portfolio Managers, Trading, Operations, Sales, and other teams across the organization to translate investment decisions into client portfolio. 
 What You'll Do: 
 We are looking for a Portfolio Implementation Associate to join our Private Wealth Portfolio Management Group (PMG) in New York, NY. 
 Responsibilities include portfolio construction and implementation, monitoring asset exposures and allocations, managing client-specific requests, tax management, pre-trade guideline monitoring, and resolving portfolio exceptions. 
 Portfolio Implementation Associates develop a deep understanding of AB's investment products, portfolio management processes, and operational infrastructure while gaining hands-on experience managing portfolios in a fast-paced investment environment. 
 Specific Responsibilities 
 Implement investment decisions across individual equity portfolios. 
 Monitor portfolio positioning, trade execution, cash levels, and compliance with client-specific investment guidelines. 
 Manage client requests and portfolio events throughout the account lifecycle, including cash flows, transitions, account openings, and account closures. 
 Support a high volume of portfolio activity and client specific requests while maintaining strong attention to accuracy, risk management, and client outcomes. 
 Partner with Senior Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Legal/Compliance, Sales, Trading, and Investment Operations/Accounting. 
 Participate in projects focused on portfolio implementation, new and evolving investment capabilities, technology and automation, scalability, and process improvement. 
 Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, controls, and portfolio implementation workflows. 
 What We're Looking For: 
 Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, liberal arts, or a related field. 
 2 - 4 years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or a related financial-services role preferred. 
 Experience supporting U.S. equities, portfolio implementation, or investment-product processes is a plus. 
 A technical background or experience working with data and analytical tools, such as AI Tools, SQL and Power BI, is helpful. 
 A strong interest in financial markets, investment management, and portfolio construction. 
 Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to evaluate portfolios and identify potential issues. 
 Excellent attention to detail and a strong risk-management mindset. 
 The ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities effectively in a deadline-driven environment. 
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across the organization. 
 The ability to think holistically, understand end-to-end processes, and challenge existing approaches when appropriate. 
 A proactive, inquisitive mindset and willingness to take ownership of new challenges. 
 An interest in using technology and automation to improve investment and operational processes. 
 About AB 
 We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.

Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you.
